title: Rerun lr 1e-4 for 1800 steps from a clean commit
rationale: finding-2: lr-1e-4 ran from an uncommitted edit, and its val acc is still rising at step 600 (0.665). Three times the steps would show whether 1e-4 ends above 3e-4.
command: node ../../src/research-harness/cli.mjs run exec --experiment learning-rate-sweep --name "lr 1e-4 1800 steps" --config configs/lr-1e-4.json --metric-def acc:maximize --metric-def loss:minimize -- node scripts/train_demo.mjs --lr 1e-4 --rank 16 --seed 1 --steps 1800

note: Not now: 3e-4 is already chosen for the rank ablation, and 1800 steps is three times this sweep’s budget. Revisit if 3e-4 turns unstable.
